**Available: Hand-Built 5E3 Tweed Deluxe-Style 12W 1x12 Tube Combo Amp**

$1,020

A hand-built, approximately 12-watt tube combo based on the 5E3 circuit, with an Electro-Harmonix 12-inch speaker. Supplied with an amplifier-specific build verification record, baseline operating measurements, and operating and safety guides. See the [instrument record](https://k7rhy.app/sn/5E326001).

[Purchase](https://shop.k7rhy.app/products/newly-built-5e3-tweed-deluxe-clone-2026) · [Product details](https://k7rhy.app/shop/amplifiers/newly-built-5e3-tweed-deluxe-clone-2026)

**Available: Custom-Assembled S-Type with Fender Custom Shop Tomatillo Pickups, Series Switch & Pro Setup - Gloss White**

$799

A custom-assembled S-type with Fender Custom Shop Tomatillo pickups, a [series switch for the paired-pickup positions](https://k7rhy.app/sn/STR26001/wiring), and a professional setup by Stage Left Custom Guitar Works. Includes a tweed hardshell case. See the [instrument record](https://k7rhy.app/sn/STR26001).

[Purchase](https://shop.k7rhy.app/products/custom-assembled-s-type-with-fender-custom-shop-tomatillo-pickups-series-switch-pro-setup-gloss-white) · [Product details](https://k7rhy.app/shop/guitars/custom-assembled-s-type-with-fender-custom-shop-tomatillo-pickups-series-switch-pro-setup-gloss-white)

**Available: Custom-Assembled S-Type with Fender CuNiFe Pickups & Neck-Add Switch - Gloss White**

$735

A custom-assembled S-type with Fender CuNiFe pickups and a [neck-add switch](https://k7rhy.app/sn/STR26002/wiring) for bridge-and-neck and all-three-pickup combinations. Includes locking tuners and a tweed hardshell case. See the [instrument record](https://k7rhy.app/sn/STR26002).

[Purchase](https://shop.k7rhy.app/products/custom-assembled-s-type-with-fender-cunife-pickups-neck-add-switch-gloss-white) · [Product details](https://k7rhy.app/shop/guitars/custom-assembled-s-type-with-fender-cunife-pickups-neck-add-switch-gloss-white)

**Available: PRS SE Custom 24 Burled Ash Limited Edition with Seymour Duncan Alnico II Pros, Partial Splits & TKL Hardshell Case - Natural**

$875

A 2024 PRS SE Custom 24 Burled Ash Limited Edition upgraded with Seymour Duncan Alnico II Pro pickups, [partial coil splits](https://k7rhy.app/sn/PRS26001/wiring), a tone bypass, and PRS locking tuners. It served as the reference guitar for [Relay](https://k7rhy.app/guitars/relay) [voicing development](https://k7rhy.app/guitars/relay/voicings) and includes a TKL hardshell case. See the [instrument record](https://k7rhy.app/sn/PRS26001).
